entries.title: Frostpunk
entries.definitive_edition: Frostpunk Game of the Year / complete DLC route on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Game of the Year / Complete DLC route
primary.why: The Windows PC route has the complete expansion path with The Rifts, The Last Autumn, and On The Edge, plus the best fidelity, mouse/keyboard control, and capture setup. PS4, Xbox One, and Mac are valid access routes but do not add exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Frostpunk on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or the official 11 bit route for Windows PC and add the Season Pass/Game of the Year DLC set.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with complete DLC path.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete route and best fidelity/capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Frostpunk: Console Edition native PS4 release.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but PC remains the preferred complete/capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Frostpunk: Console Edition native Xbox One release.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but PC remains the preferred complete/capture route.
skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows PC route is both the most complete DLC route and the best capture/fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Frostpunk: Console Edition is a port/access route, not a remaster. A Nintendo Switch version has been announced for 2026 without a sourced release date, and Frostpunk 1886 is a 2027 reimagining, so neither is added as a released entry here.

entries.title: Frostpunk: Beyond the Ice
entries.definitive_edition: Frostpunk: Beyond the Ice on iOS/iPadOS

emulation.notes: Use native mobile hardware or a capture-capable iPad/iPhone setup; do not treat this as the PC game's definitive route.

primary.why: Frostpunk: Beyond the Ice is the official mobile adaptation released on iOS and Android. iOS/iPadOS is chosen as the primary capture route for stable app-store availability and tablet capture, while Android is the equivalent alternate mobile route.
primary.how_to_play: Install Frostpunk: Beyond the Ice from the App Store on iPhone/iPad, or use the Google Play version on Android as the alternate mobile route.

all_releases.reason: primary: preferred mobile capture route for the official mobile adaptation.
skip: equivalent mobile route; iOS/iPadOS remains the selected capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The iOS and Android versions are the same official mobile adaptation route; no platform-exclusive content is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an official free-to-play mobile adaptation, not a replacement for the original PC Frostpunk.

entries.title: Frostpunk 2
entries.definitive_edition: Frostpunk 2 Deluxe Edition on Windows PC with Fractured Utopias and Breach of Trust

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Deluxe Edition / current DLC route with Fractured Utopias and Breach of Trust
primary.why: The Windows PC route has the earliest release, the current DLC path, mouse/keyboard control, and the best capture/fidelity setup. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are strong later ports, but they do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Frostpunk 2 Deluxe Edition or the base game plus Deluxe Edition Upgrade/DLC on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Microsoft Store for Windows PC. Add Fractured Utopias and Breach of Trust for the current DLC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with current DLC route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture/input route and current DLC support.
skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 console release with physical editions and DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S console release with Game Pass and DLC route.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity/capture platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Frostpunk 2 DLC is available on PC and consoles, and the PC route remains the best fidelity/capture/input route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Breach of Trust launched June 23, 2026 as the second DLC; a third DLC is still planned, so the current complete route may change. Console releases are ports/access routes, not remasters.
